# taz.de

> > taz.de is a German independent daily newspaper providing critical journalism on politics, social issues, civil rights, and cultural commentary.

The taz (die tageszeitung) covers German and international politics with progressive perspectives, featuring analysis on elections, protests, social inequality, and civil liberties. Key contributors include Sabine am Orde, David Joram, Stefan Reinecke, and Anja Maier.

## Key Topics

- German politics
- SPD election campaigns
- Social inequality and poverty
- Police tactics and civil rights
- Protest and assembly rights
- Political commentary
- Hamburg politics
- Peer Steinbrück
- Polizeikessel (police kettling)
- Versammlungsrecht (assembly law)
- Demonstrationen (protests)
- Candidate competency teams
- Progressive journalism
- Luisa Neubauer
- Court rulings on civil liberties

## Political Analysis & Elections

- [Kompetenzteam | taz.de](https://taz.de/!t5052548/): SPD election campaign analysis on Peer Steinbrück's competency team strategy

## Civil Rights & Protests

- [Polizeikessel | taz.de](https://taz.de/!t5039289/): Police kettling tactics at protests in Leipzig and Hamburg, civil rights

## Social Issues & Inequality

- [Arme | taz.de](https://taz.de/!t5042891/): Social inequality, poverty policy analysis featuring Pope Francis and Trump

## Optional

- [Alle Artikel von Stephan Trüby | taz.de](https://taz.de/Artikel-von-160944/!a160944/): Author archive for Stephan Trüby's articles on architecture and antisemitism
